checklist.evidence: src/acp_profiles.rs:10-153, src/projects.rs profile schema/validation/configure_global, src/cli.rs ACP commands, src/tui/launch.rs and src/daemon.rs:294-487: executable resolution and execution are shell-free; raw argv requires an absolute executable; configuration, names, argv and settings have explicit bounds. checklist.evidence: src/acp/settings.rs validates closed requested fields, resolves exact advertised category/option/choice identities, serializes original-session setters and checks acknowledgements and cross-setting drift. src/acp.rs:1905-2034 keeps prompt admission unavailable until configuration completes. Unreported defaults and subsequent configuration changes remain explicit. Reviewed tests/acp/omp.rs and tests/acp/profiles.rs as source, not executed proof.

src/daemon.rs:490-514,1286-1530; src/control.rs:831-849,1194-1254; src/acp.rs prepare/commit: every ACP mutation passes current capability and generation checks, then exact target validation at the serialized commit. Native and ACP target kinds cannot substitute for one another.

checklist.area: Force, cancellation, conditional keep and withdrawal
checklist.evidence: Reviewed src/control.rs claim/handle/admission transitions and src/tui/control.rs ownership panels/warnings. Force changes authority without invoking ACP interruption or process termination; ordinary pending cancellation grants nobody; conditional keep/withdraw preserves human control. Previously admitted work retains its original identities. Reviewed corresponding tests/acp.rs, tests/acp/native/acceptance.rs and tests/pty_control/native.rs assertions.

src/tui/control.rs:162-404,524-548,1143-1303 and existing src/control.rs report_view/is_original_native/consent consumers: native view, activity, consent and keep remain bound to the original live connection and relevant serial/activity revisions. A copied capability does not manufacture original-attachment activity or consent.

checklist.area: Exact daemon, instance, connection and session continuity
checklist.evidence: src/tui.rs Resume::validate and attached recovery; src/tui/control.rs:162-170,356-358; src/acp.rs Instance::exact: recovery rejects daemon/instance/connection replacement and established-session changes. Only a previously unknown session may become established on the same original tuple. Recovery connects to the existing socket and disables automatic acquisition; it does not launch a replacement agent or daemon.

src/tui/agent.rs binding/sync/capture paths, src/tui.rs event routing and teardown, src/tui/control.rs worker/stop: intercepted application input cannot fall through to a PTY or be replayed under a new grant. Old workers are fenced and joined; only an already parsed successful launch target is salvaged. Reviewed tests/acp/native/daily_use.rs and recovery_edges.rs, including paused claims, bootstrap establishment and queued launch receipts.

checklist.evidence: src/acp.rs:1773-2330 validates original sessions, typed RPC IDs, fresh canonical interaction IDs/revisions and exact offered permission IDs.
